brand.title: Brand
brand.description: The maker's brand, for example Anker, Samsung or MSI. Required: the recall search is by brand.

product.title: Product name and model
product.description: The product name with its model number if you have it, for example PowerCore 10000 A1263. A model number gives an exact match.

upc.title: UPC (optional)
upc.description: The barcode number, if you have it (several codes separated by commas also work). A UPC listed on a recall is an exact match.

products.title: Many products
products.description: One product per line as Brand | Product name | UPC (the UPC is optional), for example: Samsung | Galaxy Note7
